title: Collab Docs Drafter input
description: Release evidence bundle for openteams/cog-collab-docs-drafter. One bundle documents one release, bounded by two tags. Build it with tools/collect_evidence.py or by hand; the Cog reads only what is in the bundle.

release.description: Which release this is. The tag range is the release boundary: a branch name or a list of merged pull requests does not establish what shipped.

product.description: Product name used in the notes, e.g. Collab Desktop

previous_tag.description: Tag of the previous release (start of the range, exclusive)

target_tag.description: Tag of the release being documented (end of the range, inclusive)

target_commit.description: Commit the target tag points to

channel.description: stable, prerelease (candidate), or unknown when no release record was found

notes.description: Caveats about the bundle itself (truncations, missing records). The model sees these too.

collection.description: Provenance of the bundle. Not shown to the model.

sources.description: Evidence items. Every claim in the draft must cite these by id and quote one verbatim.

id.description: Stable id such as pr-755, issue-751, commit-477c830, release-0.7.2

url.description: Link to the original, kept for the reviewer
